messages:
mara: Thinking out loud: instead of a one-off auto-route, can we add a "migration window" concept in Console? schedule a window (start/end UTC), shadow vs enforce mode, and a per-tenant opt-in/lock. want feedback.
leo: +1 on scheduling. we should tie it to tenant SLA tier: Gold tenants get manual opt-in prompt, Bronze can be auto-enrolled with notice.
maya: UX idea: a compact "Migration Playground" on the Route page where you can select sample tenants, run quick parity checks (5k requests replayed), and then preview a scheduled window. also expose a "quota lock" toggle.
rahul: define quota lock: during the migration window, routed requests are counted against their old quota until tenant confirms migration. that prevents unexpected quota exhaustion. implementation sketch: router marks requests with `migration_session_id` and we apply a shadow decrement to legacy quota store.
kai: SDK compatibility: for web/sdk we can set a downgrade cookie `rw_pref_version=1` that client libs respect. also expose a tenant-level grace TTL so customers can roll back client-side within N days.
mara: good — two modes: shadow-mode (no quota impact, meter for preview) and lock-mode (runtime runs on v2 but decrements v1 counters). lock-mode needs caution for billing.
leo: telemetry: add a per-window summary tile showing: routed_pct, avg_token_inflation, p95_latency_delta, quota_conflicts, support_ticket_preds. keep rows per-tenant.
maya: Playground UI: run quick checks -> returns compatibility score, a short list of failing prompts (collapsed by default), and a per-tenant risk label (OK / Review / Block). also a checkbox to auto-schedule rollout cohorts.
rahul: backend: need `migration_sessions` table with session_id, route, window_start/end, mode, owners, and TTL. keep session metrics for 14 days. we must redact request payloads.
kai: opt-out flow: customers can toggle "Honor client version preference" which bypasses auto-route. add a server-side cookie check and header precedence: prefer header > cookie > tenant pin > auto-policy. document in API changelog.
mara: operational guardrails: require min sample size of 2k requests per cohort step, rollback if p95 +20% OR token_per_request +25% OR quota_conflicts > 3 tenants in 1h. deploy-bot should post each step summary.
ops-bot: (system) scheduled job queued: migration-window-4850001234-preview -> will post results when complete.
leo: billing note: lock-mode will create friction for billing because runtime still uses v2. billing needs origin/routed columns in exports and a reconcile job for lock-mode months. sam (billing) should weigh in but not in this thread.
maya: copy for deprecation banner: "We're migrating this endpoint to a new runtime during a scheduled window. You can preview impacts in Console -> Routes -> Migration Playground. Opt-out or lock quota per tenant."
rahul: action list: (1) infra migration_sessions & header hooks (rahul) (2) playground backend + sampling executor (maya) (3) router precedence + cookie handling (kai) (4) telemetry tiles + dashboard (leo). aim for a small prototype next week.
mara: If no objections, i'll file the RFC with owners and timeline. call out any legal/billing blockers before EOD.
ops-bot: (system) note: migration-window-4850001234-preview scheduled for 4850001400
